title: 第1742章 大大的惊喜包我身上没问题第1741章 搜了个寂寞被耍了
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
本来焱黎正打算和夜云说这件事情的，却没想到，夜云竟然已经猜出来了。
“哦？真有后手？说说看。”
夜云来了兴趣，很好奇焱黎所谓的后手是什么。
不仅是夜云，苏卿雪同样也很好奇。
现在魔傀已经被抓住了，焱黎究竟能有什么后手。
抿嘴一笑，焱黎随即摊开右手。
在她手上，有一种看上去幽绿色的粉末。
“主上，这就是我的后手，由鬼蛾毒粉制作而成的特殊粉状剧毒，被称为幽冥毒粉。
哪怕只是吸入少量，也会对身体造成极大的损害，尤其是内脏。
在炼制魔傀时，我就在他的体内存放了不少幽冥毒粉。
一旦自爆，魔傀体内的幽冥毒粉便会在瞬间炸裂开。
若没能提前进行隔离，凡是接触或是吸入幽冥毒粉的目标，都会中毒。
即便是天魔，也无法完全抵抗幽冥毒粉的剧毒。”
原来如此！
夜云默默竖起了大拇指，感叹焱黎的提前安排。
只能说，真不愧是最毒妇人心！
的确厉害，在炼制魔傀时，焱黎就已经想好魔傀被俘虏后该怎么做。
“阿黎，魔傀已经被抓，留着也没什么用。
那就给他们上演最后一场演出吧。”
靠着幽冥毒粉，不大可能把冥鬼教高层全灭，但至少能让他们难受。

一点点折磨他们，这才是真正意义上的复仇。
脸上露出一抹得逞的笑容，焱黎自然明白夜云的意思。
“知道了，主上，他们……一定会喜欢这个惊喜的。”
这的确是惊喜，而且还是大大的“惊喜”！
…………
阴冥山脉中心的冥鬼教大殿内。
五长老很快便带着三长老赶来。
一路上，五长老已经向三长老说明了情况。
本就对奇淫技巧很感兴趣的三长老，对魔罗被炼制的魔傀自然是相当感兴趣。
他虽然没有直接研究过魔傀，但也曾在古籍上有所接触。
如今有一个真的魔傀摆在眼前，不好好的试验一番怎么行。
刚来的大殿，五长老便发现其他长老和护法也都来了。
想来应该是教主的安排，想尽快弄清楚那具魔傀身上隐藏的秘密。
刚走进来的三长老，目光第一时间就落在了柱子边的魔傀身上，他的眼睛都在放光。
大殿内长老和护法们，纷纷将目光聚焦在三长老身上。
他们刚才也看过了，对这魔傀自然是束手无策。
毕竟他们本就不精通此道，要想把魔傀的情况完全弄清楚，谈何容易。
五长老轻轻推了一下双眼放光的三长老，神色恭敬道。
“启禀教主，三长老到了。”
位于大殿上方座椅上的冥鬼教主，缓缓睁开双眼。

“三长老，此事交给你，有问题吗？”
content_en:
Originally, Yan Li was planning to tell Ye Yun about this matter, but unexpectedly, Ye Yun had already guessed it.
"Oh? Do you really have a back-up plan? Tell me."
Ye Yun became interested and curious about what Yan Li meant.
Not only Ye Yun, Su Qingxue was also curious.
Now that the demon puppet has been caught, what kind of backup plan can Yan Li have?
With a pursed smile, Yan Li immediately spread his right hand.
On her hand, there was a green-looking powder.
"Lord, this is my back-up plan, a special powdery poison made from ghost moth poison powder, called Nether Poison Powder.
Inhaling even a small amount can cause great damage to the body, especially the internal organs.
When refining the demon puppet, I stored a lot of Nether Poison Powder in his body.
Once it self-destructs, the Nether Poison Powder in the demon puppet's body will explode in an instant.
If isolation is not carried out in advance, any target that comes into contact with or inhales the Nether Poison Powder will be poisoned.
Even the demon cannot completely resist the poison of Nether Poison Powder. "
That’s it!
Ye Yun silently gave a thumbs up and lamented Yan Li's advance arrangements.
All I can say is that she is truly the most poisonous woman!
It is indeed powerful. When refining the demon puppet, Yan Li had already thought about what to do if the demon puppet was captured.
"Ali, the demon puppet has been captured, there is no use keeping it.
Then give them one last show. "
Relying on the Nether Poison Powder, it is unlikely that all the top leaders of the Netherworld Sect will be wiped out, but it will at least make them uncomfortable.
Torturing them bit by bit is the true sense of revenge.
With a successful smile on his face, Yan Li naturally understood what Ye Yun meant.
"I know, Lord, they... will definitely like this surprise."
This is indeed a surprise, and it is a big "surprise"!
…………
In the main hall of the Underworld Sect in the center of the Yinming Mountains.
The fifth elder came quickly with the third elder.
Along the way, the fifth elder had already explained the situation to the third elder.
The third elder, who was already very interested in strange and obscene techniques, was naturally very interested in the demon puppet that was refined by Mo Luo.
Although he has not directly studied demon puppets, he has also had some contact with them in ancient books.
Now that there is a real demon puppet in front of us, how can we not give it a good test?
As soon as they arrived at the main hall, the fifth elder found that other elders and protectors had also arrived.
Presumably it was the arrangement of the leader, who wanted to find out the secret hidden in the demon puppet as soon as possible.
The third elder who had just walked in, his eyes immediately fell on the demon puppet beside the pillar, and his eyes were shining.
The elders and guardians in the hall focused their attention on the third elder.
They had seen it just now and were naturally helpless to do anything about this demon puppet.
After all, they are not proficient in this art. It is not easy to completely understand the situation of the demon puppet.
The fifth elder gently pushed the third elder, whose eyes were shining, and said respectfully.
"Reporting to the leader, the third elder has arrived."
The Ghost Leader, who was sitting on the seat above the main hall, slowly opened his eyes.
"Third Elder, I leave this matter to you. Do you have any questions?"
